计算超越单边偏差的平衡Computing Equilibrium beyond Unilateral Deviation

Mingyang Liu 1, Gabriele Farina1, Asuman Ozdaglar 1
1 LIDS, EECS, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
1 {liumy19,gfarina,asuman}@mit.edu
摘要Abstract

大多数熟悉的均衡概念，例如纳什和相关均衡，只能保证没有一个参与者可以通过单方面偏离来提高其效用。他们不保证联盟不会出现有利可图的协调偏差。尽管文献提出了针对多边偏差提供稳定性的解决方案概念（Most familiar equilibrium concepts, such as Nash and correlated equilibrium, guarantee only that no single player can improve their utility by deviating unilaterally. They offer no guarantees against profitable coordinated deviations by coalitions. Although the literature proposes solution concepts that provide stability against multilateral deviations (例如e.g.、强纳什均衡和防联盟均衡），这些通常不存在。在本文中，我们研究了一种替代解决方案概念，该概念可以最大限度地减少联盟偏差激励，而不是要求它们消失，因此保证存在。具体来说，我们专注于最小化偏离联盟的平均增益，并将框架扩展到加权平均和最大联盟内增益。相比之下，最小增益类似物在计算上很困难。对于平均增益和最大增益目标，我们证明了计算这种平衡的复杂性的下限，并提出了匹配该界限的算法。最后，我们使用我们的框架来解决, strong Nash and coalition-proof equilibrium), these generally fail to exist. In this paper, we study an alternative solution concept that minimizes coalitional deviation incentives, rather than requiring them to vanish, and is therefore guaranteed to exist. Specifically, we focus on minimizing the average gain of a deviating coalition, and extend the framework to weighted-average and maximum-within-coalition gains. In contrast, the minimum-gain analogue is shown to be computationally intractable. For the average-gain and maximum-gain objectives, we prove a lower bound on the complexity of computing such an equilibrium and present an algorithm that matches this bound. Finally, we use our framework to solve the可利用性福利前沿Exploitability Welfare Frontier(EWF)，在给定可利用性的情况下可达到的最大社会福利（所有单方面偏差的最大收益）。(EWF), the maximum attainable social welfare subject to a given exploitability (the maximum gain over all unilateral deviations).

1 简介Introduction

迄今为止研究的大多数均衡概念，例如纳什均衡（NE）Most equilibrium concepts studied so far, such as Nash equilibrium (NE)(Nash, 1950), 相关平衡 (CE), correlated equilibrium (CE)(Aumann, 1974), 粗相关平衡 (CCE), coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE)(Moulin and Vial, 1978)和 Stackelberg 平衡, and Stackelberg equilibrium(Von Stackelberg, 2010)，仅保证, guarantee only that没有个人玩家no individual player具有改善偏差的单方面效用。然而，当多个参与者同时偏离并形成联盟时，它们并不能提供任何保证。在本文中，我们解决以下问题：has a unilateral utility improving deviation. However, they offer no guarantees when multiple players deviate simultaneously by forming a coalition. In this paper, we address the following question:

捕捉多边偏差的适当概念是什么？如何有效地计算它？What is an appropriate notion for capturing multilateral deviations, and how can it be computed efficiently?

先前解决联盟偏差的概念，例如强NEPrevious notions that address coalition deviations, such as strong NE(Aumann, 1959)111在本文中，我们使用术语In this paper, we use the term强均衡strong equilibrium泛指任何考虑多边偏差的均衡概念。to broadly refer to any equilibrium concept that considers multilateral deviations.和防联盟均衡and coalition-proof equilibrium(Bernheim et al., 1987)，大多在一般游戏中不存在（不像NE）。因此，我们不是寻找一个不受所有联盟偏差影响的联合策略，而是专注于计算一个联合策略：, mostly fail to exist in general games (unlike NE). Therefore, instead of searching for a joint strategy immune to all coalition deviations, we focus on computing a joint strategy that最小化minimizes最大平均增益the maximum average gain222我们的框架还扩展到基于参与者偏差增益的加权总和或加权平均值的联盟目标，以及基于最大联盟内偏差增益的目标。相比之下，即使对于小型游戏，相应的最小增益变体在计算上也很困难。参见Our framework also extends to coalition objectives based on weighted sums or weighted averages of players’ deviation gains, as well as objectives based on the maximum within-coalition deviation gain. In contrast, the corresponding minimum-gain variant is computationally intractable even for small games. In other words, we aim to compute the most stable strategy profile, even if a perfectly stable one does not exist. We refer to this notion as the最小平均强均衡Minimum Average-Strong Equilibrium（马斯）。(MASE).

This demonstrates that our hardness result is tight and establishes the treewidth as the definitive parameter characterizing the complexity of computing the MASE. While the problem is hard in general, it becomes tractable for games where the underlying interaction structure is not too complex. The key idea of our algorithm involves breaking the game into small, overlapping, weakly interacting parts, solving the problem locally on each part, and then combining these local solutions consistently.

  3. 3.

    适用于福利-可利用性权衡。Application to welfare-exploitability tradeoffs.我们展示了如何使用我们的框架来计算受规定的可利用性预算影响的社会最优策略，从而表征可利用性福利边界（We show how our framework can be used to compute socially optimal strategies subject to a prescribed exploitability budget, thereby characterizing the exploitability welfare frontier (Section˜9).

技术概述。Technical Overview.

In Section˜7，我们将强均衡计算问题表述为相关器和偏差器之间的两人零和元博弈。相关器为原始游戏中的所有参与者选择相关的联合策略，而偏差器选择一个联盟以及该联盟的联合偏差。这个博弈是零和博弈，因为相关器寻求最小化联盟从偏差中获得的收益，而偏差器则寻求最大化它。, we formulate the strong-equilibrium computation problem as a two-player zero-sum meta-game between a correlator and a deviator. The correlator chooses a correlated joint strategy for all players in the original game, whereas the deviator chooses a coalition together with a joint deviation for that coalition. The game is zero-sum because the correlator seeks to minimize the coalition’s gain from deviation, while the deviator seeks to maximize it.

主要的计算挑战是这个元游戏中两个玩家的动作空间呈指数级大：相关器的动作是联合动作配置文件，偏差器的动作是联盟偏差对。标准的游戏解决方法，例如无悔学习The main computational challenge is that the action spaces of both players in this meta-game are exponentially large: the correlator’s actions are joint action profiles, and the deviator’s actions are coalition-deviation pairs. Standard game-solving approaches, such as no-regret learning(Hazan et al., 2016)和线性规划and linear programming(Papadimitriou and Roughgarden, 2008)，通常会根据玩家之间最大的动作空间进行缩放，因此直接应用它们在计算上是很困难的。为了克服这个障碍，我们通过跟随不安的领导者（FTPL）实例化无悔学习, typically scale with the largest action space among the players, so applying them directly is computationally intractable. To overcome this obstacle, we instantiate no-regret learning with Follow the Perturbed Leader (FTPL)(Hazan et al., 2016)。每个 FTPL 更新都简化为优化相关单纯形上的线性目标，其最佳值是在极值点达到的。因此，在每次迭代时计算和存储纯策略就足够了，而不是维持完整的指数维分布。. Each FTPL update reduces to optimizing a linear objective over the relevant simplex, whose optimum is attained at an extreme point. Thus, it suffices to compute and store a pure strategy at each iteration rather than maintain the full exponential-dimensional distribution.

最后，我们通过动态规划对线性优化预言进行树分解Finally, we solve the resulting linear optimization oracle via dynamic programming over a tree decomposition of the˜Utility Dependency Graph。这会产生仅在树宽上呈指数增长的运行时间. This yields a running time that is exponential only in the treewidth of the˜Utility Dependency Graph，而不是玩家数量。因此，该算法对于以下游戏是有效的：, rather than in the number of players. Consequently, the algorithm is efficient for games whose˜Utility Dependency Graph树宽有界。此外，它对树宽的指数依赖性与下界相匹配has bounded treewidth. Moreover, its exponential dependence on the treewidth matches the lower bound in˜6.3.

2 相关工作Related Work

在本节中，我们从存在性、时间复杂度和计算方法三个角度回顾强均衡的文献。In this section, we review the literature on strong equilibrium from three perspectives: existence, time complexity, and computation methods.

强均衡的存在。Existence of Strong Equilibrium.

Aumann (1959)引入了强 NE，其中任何联盟（参与者的非空子集）都不能以严格提高所有成员效用的方式偏离。然而，即使是简单的两人游戏，例如囚徒困境introduced the strong NE, where no coalition (a nonempty subset of players) can deviate in a way that strictly improves the utility of all its members. However, even in simple two-player games such as Prisoner’s Dilemma(Luce and Raiffa, 1957)，当玩家可以同时偏离时，就不存在强NE。为了解决这个问题，, a strong NE does not exist when players can deviate simultaneously. To address this,Bernheim et al. (1987)提出了联盟证明均衡，它限制了偏差的集合（参见proposed the coalition-proof equilibrium, which restricts the set of deviations (seeSection˜5了解详情）。然而，这个概念也无法保证在三人游戏中的存在for details). Yet, this concept also fails to guarantee existence, already in three-player games(Bernheim et al., 1987)。最近，. More recently,Rahn and Schäfer (2015)研究了这个概念studied the notion ofα\alpha- 大约-approximatekk- 平衡，最多没有大小联盟-equilibrium, where no coalition of size at mostkk可以偏离，使得每个成员的效用至少变为can deviate so that every member’s utility becomes at leastα≥1\alpha\geq 1倍于其原始效用。他们进一步表明，这种均衡仅在特定条件下存在于图协调博弈中，例如，当times their original utility. They further showed that such equilibria exist in graph coordination games only under specific conditions, for instance, whenα≥2\alpha\geq 2。受这些不存在结果的激励，我们转而专注于最小化联盟偏差的最大平均增益. Motivated by these non-existence results, we instead focus on minimizing the maximum average gain from coalition deviations˜MASE，一个总是明确定义的量。, a quantity that is always well defined.

强平衡的复杂性。Complexity of Strong Equilibrium.

由于当仅考虑单例联盟时，强NE会退化为NE，因此计算强NE是Since a strong NE degenerates to an NE when only singleton coalitions are considered, computing a strong NE is帕帕德PPAD- 总体来说很难-hard in general(Daskalakis et al., 2009; Chen and Deng, 2006)。除了计算之外，. Beyond computation,Conitzer and Sandholm (2008)表明即使决定是否存在强 NEshowed that even deciding whether a strong NE exists isNP-完成两人对称游戏，以及-complete in two-player symmetric games, andBerthelsen and Hansen (2022)进一步确定问题是further established that the problem is∃ℝ\mathsf{\exists\mathbb{R}}- 适合三人游戏。同样，-complete for three-player games. Similarly,Rahn and Schäfer (2015)证明了确定强NE的存在是proved that determining the existence of a strong NE isNP-在图形协调游戏中完成，即使将注意力限制在恒定大小的联盟上。然而，据我们所知，当允许联合策略相关时，没有已知的硬度结果可用于计算强平衡，-complete in graph coordination games, even when restricting attention to coalitions of constant size. To the best of our knowledge, however, no hardness results are known for computing strong equilibria when correlation on the joint strategy is allowed,即i.e.，一种不受联盟偏差影响的相关策略。在本文中，我们表明，计算最小化联盟偏差的平均增益的相关策略是, a correlated strategy immune to coalition deviations. In this paper, we show that computing a correlated strategy that minimizes the average gain from coalition deviations isNP-很难。此外，我们根据树宽建立一个下界-hard. Moreover, we establish a lower bound based on the treewidth of the˜Utility Dependency Graph，展示了求解此处考虑的 MASE 时固有的计算障碍。, demonstrating an inherent computational barrier in solving the MASE considered here.

强平衡的计算。Computation of Strong Equilibrium.

Holzman and Law-Yone (1997)和andRozenfeld and Tennenholtz (2006)开发了计算强 NE 的算法，并在多项式时间内的某些条件下关联拥塞博弈中的强均衡。developed algorithms to compute strong NE and correlated strong equilibria in congestion games under certain conditions in polynomial time.Rahn and Schäfer (2015)表明当在树上定义图协调博弈时，也可以在多项式时间内计算出强 NE。相比之下，showed that a strong NE can also be computed in polynomial time when the graph coordination game is defined on a tree. In contrast,Gatti et al. (2013)提出了一种空间分支定界算法，用于更普遍地计算强NE，但其运行时间是指数级的。沿着同样的路线，proposed a spatial branch-and-bound algorithm for computing strong NE more generally, but its runtime is exponential. Along the same lines,Nessah and Tian (2014)还提供了计算上难以处理的算法。具有独立的兴趣，also provided a computationally intractable algorithm. Of independent interest,Papadimitriou and Roughgarden (2008)引入了一种计算最佳 CE 的有效算法，introduced an efficient algorithm for computing optimal CE,例如e.g.，图形游戏中社会福利最大化的CE, a CE that maximizes the social welfare, in graphical games(Kearns et al., 2001; Kakade et al., 2003)具有有界树宽，使用线性规划。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于无悔学习的 MASE 计算新算法，其时间复杂度与树宽规定的下限相匹配。with bounded treewidth, using linear programming. In this paper, we develop a new algorithm for computing MASE based on no-regret learning, with a time complexity that matches the lower bound dictated by the treewidth of the˜Utility Dependency Graph.

4 最小平均强均衡 (MASE)Minimum Average-Strong Equilibrium (MASE)

强均衡的几个概念已经被提出，包括强纳什均衡（NE）Several notions of strong equilibrium have been proposed, including the strong Nash equilibrium (NE)(Aumann, 1959), 强总和 NE, the sum-strong NE(Hoefer, 2013)（任何联盟的总收益都没有改善），以及联盟证明均衡(no improvement on the total gain of any coalition), and coalition-proof equilibrium(Bernheim et al., 1987)（只允许自我执行的偏差，请参阅(permits only self-enforcing deviations, seeSection˜5）。然而，这些概念都不能保证在一般游戏中存在。为了建立直觉，我们首先说明为什么囚徒困境中不存在强NE。稍后，我们将证明即使允许相关策略，问题仍然存在。). However, none of these notions are guaranteed to exist in general games. To build intuition, we first illustrate why a strong NE does not exist in Prisoner’s Dilemma. Later, we will show that the problem persists even when correlated strategies are allowed.

10 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们引入了最小平均强均衡（MASE），这是一个易于处理的解决方案概念，通过最小化每个联盟的平均偏差动机来解释多边偏差。我们确定计算近似 MASE 是In this work, we introduced the Minimum Average-Strong Equilibrium (MASE), a tractable solution concept that accounts for multilateral deviations by minimizing each coalition’s average incentive to deviate. We established that computing an approximate MASE isNP-即使对于单例联盟也是困难的，并且证明了一个下界，显示出对树宽的不可避免的指数依赖性-hard even with singleton coalitions and proved a lower bound showing unavoidable exponential dependence on the treewidth of the˜Utility Dependency Graph。为了补充这些硬度结果，我们设计了一种算法，将相关器-偏差元博弈与 FTPL 更新和树分解动态规划相结合。它对树宽的指数依赖性与下限相匹配。我们还展示了如何使用该框架来计算可利用性福利边界（EWF）。根据经验，MASE 对联盟偏差的鲁棒性比标准基线要强得多，同时改善了规范博弈中的社会福利，并且通常几乎不会导致单方面可利用性的增加。最后，我们证明了最小化每个联盟内的最小偏差增益，. Complementing these hardness results, we design an algorithm that combines a correlator-deviator meta-game with FTPL updates and dynamic programming over a tree decomposition. Its exponential dependence on the treewidth matches the lower bound. We also showed how this framework can be used to compute the exploitability welfare frontier (EWF). Empirically, MASE is substantially more robust to coalition deviations than standard baselines, while improving social welfare in canonical games and often incurring little to no increase in unilateral exploitability. Finally, we showed that minimizing the minimum deviation gain within each coalition,即i.e.，计算最小强 CCE，也是, computing a minimum strong CCE, is alsoNP-困难，即使联合行动空间是玩家数量的多项式。这进一步促使我们关注最小化平均联盟收益。-hard, even when the joint action space is polynomial in the number of players. This further motivates our focus on minimizing average coalitional gain.

H.1 实验细节Experimental Details

对于所有基线，我们为每个玩家独立运行每个算法，因此平均策略收敛到 CCEFor all baselines, we run each algorithm independently for each player, thus the average strategy converges to a CCE(Hazan et al., 2016)。对于. ForFTRL, 对冲Hedge, 和, and奥米德OMD, 每个玩家, each playeri∈[N]i\in[N]用均匀分布初始化is initialized with a uniform distributionπi(1)\pi_{i}^{(1)}高于所有行动。over all actions.硕士MASE和andFTPL使用从所有纯策略中统一随机选择的纯策略进行初始化。are initialized with a pure strategy chosen uniformly at random from all pure strategies.

H.2 实用功能Utility Functions

本小节指定所有四个游戏的实用函数。This subsection specifies the utility functions for all four games.

囚徒困境。Prisoner’s Dilemma.

效用矩阵如图所示The utility matrix is shown inTable˜2。如果两名囚犯都认罪，他们将获得减刑。如果其中一人坦白，而另一人叛变，则坦白者将被监禁，而叛逃者将立即被释放。如果两人都背叛，两人的监禁时间将比相互坦白案中的监禁时间更长，以惩罚不诚实行为。. If both prisoners confess, they receive reduced sentences. If one confesses while the other defects, the confessor is imprisoned and the defector is released immediately. If both defect, both are imprisoned for longer than in the mutual-confession case to penalize dishonesty.

雄鹿狩猎。Stag Hunt.

效用矩阵如图所示The utility matrix is shown inTable˜3。雄鹿的奖励更高，但只有双方都选择雄鹿才能成功猎杀；单独的雄鹿尝试不会有任何结果。野兔的回报较小，但可由一个玩家获得。. A stag yields a higher reward, but it can only be hunted successfully if both players choose Stag; a solo stag attempt yields nothing. A hare provides a smaller payoff but can be secured by a single player.

吃鸡游戏。Chicken Game.

两名司机相向而行，可以转弯或直行。如果一个人直行而另一个人转弯，则转弯的玩家“输”。如果两者都直行，就会崩溃。Two drivers head toward each other and can either swerve or go straight. If one goes straight while the other swerves, the swerving player "loses". If both go straight, they crash.

庇古网．Pigou Network.

我们使用庇古网络的三人变体。每个玩家选择一个We use a three-player variant of Pigou’s network. Each player chooses a快fast or 慢slow路线。缓慢的路线产生恒定的效用route. The slow route yields a constant utility of0.250.25。快速路线带来实用性. The fast route yields utility1.5−0.5⋅(number of players choosing the fast route)1.5-0.5\cdot(\text{number of players choosing the fast route})，反映拥堵情况。, reflecting congestion.

H.3 额外的实验结果Additional Experimental Results

Figure˜8报告了有关小鸡游戏和庇古网络的更多实验。reports additional experiments on the Chicken game and Pigou’s network.硕士MASE在联盟可利用性和社会福利方面始终优于基线。在庇古的网络中，纯粹自利的参与者过度使用快速路线，而在均衡状态下，该路线会变得很慢。相比之下，当玩家组成联盟并考虑联盟内的平均效用时，他们会共享路线，以便每个人都过得更好。consistently outperforms the baselines in both coalition exploitability and social welfare. In Pigou’s network, purely self-interested players overuse the fast route, which in equilibrium becomes slow. By contrast, when players form coalitions and consider average utility within a coalition, they share the routes so that everyone is better off.

Figure˜9显示了小鸡博弈和庇古网络中可利用性和社会福利之间的权衡。shows the trade-off between exploitability and social welfare in the Chicken game and Pigou’s network.

Figure˜10报告具有不同数量的玩家、动作集大小和交互密度的多矩阵游戏的算法运行时间。reports the runtime of the algorithm for polymatrix games with varying numbers of players, action set sizes, and interaction densities.

附录一Appendix I多矩阵游戏Polymatrix Games

在本节中，我们将介绍 MASE 在具有大量玩家的游戏上的实验细节。我们选择多矩阵游戏作为这些大规模实验的基准。这种选择是由其固有的图形结构推动的，该结构允许高效生成具有低树宽的实例。In this section, we present experimental details for MASE on games with a larger number of players. We select polymatrix games as the benchmark for these large-scale experiments. This choice is motivated by their inherent graphical structure, which allows for the efficient generation of instances with a low treewidth of their˜Utility Dependency Graph.

我们从正式定义开始。多矩阵游戏有相应的无向图We begin with the formal definition. A polymatrix game has a corresponding undirected graph𝒢U=(𝒱U,ℰU)\mathcal{G}^{U}=(\mathcal{V}^{U},\mathcal{E}^{U}), 与, with𝒱U=[N]\mathcal{V}^{U}=[N]。对于任何联合行动. For any joint action𝒂∈𝒜\bm{a}\in\mathcal{A}，任何玩家的效用, the utility of any playerii定义为：is defined as:

𝒰i​(𝒂)≔∑(i,j)∈ℰU𝒰i,j​(ai,aj),\displaystyle\mathcal{U}_{i}(\bm{a})\coloneqq\sum_{(i,j)\in\mathcal{E}^{U}}\mathcal{U}_{i,j}(a_{i},a_{j}), (I.1)
